name: GitFlow Studio
subtitle: Native Git and visual merges
description:
A native Git workspace for macOS. Review changes, stage files, hunks or individual lines, create commits, and explore repository history. Manage branches, remotes, stashes, tags and linked worktrees.

Resolve supported text conflicts with current and incoming versions above an editable merged result. Choose individual conflict regions, review the result, then explicitly stage and continue the Git operation.

GitFlow Studio uses your installed Git and existing authentication infrastructure. No GitFlow Studio account or telemetry is required.
